reason: This gap examines how maternal physical health conditions are recorded differently between SUID cases (NCFRP_v51) and live births (PRAMS_P7_ARF). Understanding these differences is crucial because discrepancies in measurement can lead to biased comparisons when studying risk factors for SUID. If the recording methods differ significantly, it could affect the validity of conclusions drawn from case-population studies comparing SUID cases with live births.
